dimensions.detail: The skill is marked always: true (metadata and top-level flags). That forces the skill to be included in every agent run and increases its autonomy/visibility beyond normal expectations for a niche storytelling helper. While the skill's behavior otherwise appears harmless, always:true is an unexpected privilege without justification and raises the blast radius if the skill were later modified or maliciously repurposed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a coherent, instruction-only storytelling helper with included templates and examples, and it does not request credentials or install software. However, it is marked always: true which forces the skill to be loaded in every agent session — an uncommon privilege for a single-purpose creative assistant. Consider asking the publisher why always:true is required (or remove/disable that flag) before installing. If you proceed, restrict it to user-invoked mode (do not keep it always-enabled) so it runs only when you explicitly call it. If you manage agents for others, prefer skills that are not force-enabled platform-wide.
